speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with hematuria and right flank pain. To help me narrow down the cause, how long have these symptoms been occurring, and have you noticed any fever or chills?

speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrolithiasis (Kidney Stone)

Given your history of recurrent UTIs and the classic presentation of right flank pain with hematuria, I need to confirm if you have passed any stones or experienced nausea/vomiting. I will also need to see your urine analysis and blood work to rule out infection or obstruction. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Blood_Culture, Blood_Creatinine
